notes.provenance: REAL capture via tools/gen-schema-v2-fixtures.mjs (headless Chromium, CH's shipped recorder). The three clipboard events are dispatched as ClipboardEvents carrying a real DataTransfer, because headless Chromium has no system clipboard to paste from; the capture path reads `e.clipboardData.getData('text')` and cannot tell the two apart. Everything else — the keystrokes, the coalesced input.value stream, the keyframe — is ordinary interaction.
notes.what_this_fixture_is_for: Spec §5.3 defines TWO conforming producer modes and says players must render sensibly with either. jspsych-full is neither (jsPsych's demo timeline has no clipboard trial), so before this fixture the corpus carried no clipboard event at all and the length-only branch of every player was unexercised. This is CH's documented default (`clipboardContent: false`), and the mode's whole claim is the shape asserted below.
notes.the_two_modes: LENGTH-ONLY means `len` set and `text`/`html` null — not absent. The distinction matters: §5.3's fields are `string | null`, so an explicit null is the producer saying 'there was content and it is not here', which is a different claim from a key nobody wrote. The paste carries len 50; copy and cut carry len null, because the clipboard is not populated when they fire and any number read there would be a fiction about the selection. That asymmetry is the part a content-mode reader is most likely to get wrong, so all three events are pinned as whole objects rather than field by field.
notes.leak_scan: Not a §8 scan — nothing here is redacted, and the fixture would be lying if it claimed otherwise. It is the length-only mode's OWN floor: the pasted string was 50 characters of text that never belonged to the page, and the mode exists because pasted text routinely carries identifying material from outside it. `absent` proves the payload did not ride along in either format; `"len": 50` proves the event is there to have withheld it.
notes.no_redaction_leak: Holds vacuously — no event carries a `redacted` marker. redacted.json is where the privacy floor bites.
notes.checkpoints: None: every claim this fixture makes is about the wire, and the clipboard events have no reconstruction to read.
